desc: remove_guest in a relay room: the host removes the guest, whose game then joins the room's code again: turned away once ('The host removed you from the room.' once), and it stops there (no new try, no new key, never in the room again)

log_must: net: player 2 removed from the room
net: a removed player's game came back: turned away
log_must_not: (?s)came back: turned away.*came back: turned away

log_must: co-op: the host removed this player
net: refused: The host removed you from the room\.
log_must_not: (?s)net: refused: The host removed you.*net: refused: The host removed you
(?s)net: refused: The host removed you.*key agreed
(?s)net: refused: The host removed you.*net: in the relay's room
